nodes.label: Extension account authentication
nodes.rationale: src/routes/api/public/auth.$action.ts accepts email/password; an auth trigger creates usernames in public.profiles. Sharing requires an account.

nodes.label: Chrome extension packaging
nodes.rationale: Manifest V3 plain JavaScript has no build step; changes in extension/ must be re-zipped into public/pagewright-extension.zip for the download page.

nodes.label: Lovable commit synchronization
nodes.rationale: Avoid rewriting published Git history because connected-branch pushes synchronize to Lovable and history rewrites may lose project history.

nodes.label: OpenRouter strict JSON planning
nodes.rationale: Server-side chat completions use OPENROUTER_API_KEY and strict JSON schema validation; no alternate provider fallback is permitted when the key is missing, keeping selection and billing predictable.

nodes.label: Pagewright operation tests
nodes.rationale: extension/pagewright.js exposes globalThis.Pagewright; sorting, date and filtering logic is tested in src/test/pagewright-ops.test.ts.

nodes.label: Public reshape planning endpoint
nodes.rationale: src/routes/api/public/reshape.ts is public, CORS-open and input-size-capped so extensions can call it from any site; planning logic resides in src/server/reshape.server.ts.

nodes.label: Community account dialog
nodes.rationale: An account is needed to share setups; trying setups works without one. The dialog exposes email/password sign-in and optional username fields for account creation.

nodes.label: Browse and filter community setups
nodes.rationale: Popular, Browse and My setups navigation accompanies website/search filters, most-liked/newest/most-tried/title sorting, grid/list/compact views and a likes-only filter.

nodes.label: Pick element and change page
nodes.rationale: The panel provides an element picker, natural-language instruction input, preset requests for newest-first sorting, hiding ads, larger text and dark mode, and a Change page action.

nodes.label: Keep changes or undo
nodes.rationale: Results show a summary and operation list with controls to keep on this site, keep on all sites, or undo and forget; a saved list is labeled Kept on this site.

nodes.label: Natural-language local page customization
nodes.rationale: The stated product goal is a Chrome extension that accepts natural-language requests such as chronological LinkedIn sorting and changes the local DOM.

nodes.label: Extension interface polish status
nodes.rationale: The checklist marks responsive shared panel/community styling, stable updates/loading feedback, simulated extension-service verification and repackaging complete. Native Chrome installation remains unverified.

nodes.label: OpenRouter migration verification
nodes.rationale: Provider replacement and coding-model selection are checked complete. Request formatting, plan validation, missing-key feedback and a real OpenRouter request remain unchecked in this document.

nodes.label: CSP-safe JSON DOM operations
nodes.rationale: The AI returns a small JSON list of DOM operations executed by extension/pagewright.js; the extension never executes AI-generated code, preserving CSP compatibility.

nodes.label: Server-owned authenticated sharing
nodes.rationale: public.shared_configs is publicly readable; only public configs APIs write through the admin client after shape/size validation. The server verifies bearer tokens and stamps author_name and user_id.

nodes.label: Shared semantic UI tokens
nodes.rationale: popup.css supplies semantic color and control tokens; hub.css supplies community layout overrides. Update active-tab state without reloading to preserve drafts and focus.

nodes.label: Route filename conventions
nodes.rationale: Examples document index routes, bare-dollar dynamic parameters, optional segments, dollar splats accessed through _splat and underscore layout routes. routeTree.gen.ts is generated and should not be hand-edited.

nodes.label: TanStack Start file-based routing
nodes.rationale: Every .tsx route file defines a route; src/routes/__root.tsx is the only root layout and must preserve Outlet. Next.js and Remix directory conventions must not be introduced.
